description: Search your gallery of images, videos, audio and 3D models: returns image_id, media_type, URLs, titles and source metadata. Filter with media_type; a 3D model (media_type model_3d) also carries model_url and model_format, and its image_id is the model_id the 3D tools take. Never returns file bytes.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from the previous page's nextCursor

limit.description: Max items to return (at most 25, the default); page with nextCursor for more.

media_type.description: Only return this kind of gallery item.

name: chargen_search_gallery
title: Search image gallery
